about: Funding programs for affordable OWNERSHIP homes in Orange County. Terms come only from the program page as read by the organizers (lane repo DATA-SOURCES.md, checked 2026-11-06). Where the page gives no per-home amount, amount is null: the tool asks the user for an expected award and labels it ASSUMPTION. Status: confirmed = program page live with stated terms; funds_unconfirmed = terms read but money availability not confirmed (drawings, rounds); unknown = terms not read.

programs.name: CalHFA MyHome Assistance
programs.what: Junior loan for down payment / closing costs
programs.caveat: Buyer must qualify and use a CalHFA first mortgage. Uses the conservative 3% conventional figure.

programs.name: CalHFA Dream For All
programs.terms_read: Up to 20% of price, not to exceed $150,000; voucher registration and randomized drawing
programs.caveat: Awarded by drawing; availability of funds not confirmed. Never counted toward closing the gap.

programs.name: FHLBank San Francisco WISH
programs.what: Down-payment grant via a member bank
programs.terms_read: Grants for first-time buyers via member banks (per-home amount not read)
programs.caveat: Enter the amount from your member bank's current WISH allocation.

programs.name: HCD CalHome (via Homeownership Super NOFA)
programs.what: State homeownership funds to local agencies and nonprofits
programs.terms_read: Program page and current NOFA live; per-home award not read
programs.caveat: Competitive round; enter the award you applied for.

programs.name: FHLBank San Francisco AHP
programs.terms_read: Competitive grants and subsidized advances (amount not read)

programs.name: Orange County Housing Finance Trust
programs.terms_read: Programs page shows a NOFA; no homeownership terms read
programs.caveat: Check whether the current NOFA allows ownership projects.

programs.name: Santa Ana My First Home
programs.terms_read: Program page loads; loan terms NOT read at the source
programs.caveat: Only for Santa Ana homes. Read terms on the page before entering an amount.

excluded.name: CalHFA Forgivable Equity Builder
excluded.reason: No official page found; a 2022 CalHFA board handout said it was winding down. Not modeled as open.

excluded.name: LIHTC
excluded.reason: Rental only; not applicable to ownership.
